name: json-render
description: Renders AI-generated JSON specs into UIs built only from a developer-defined component catalog, with renderers for React, Vue, Svelte, React Native, PDF, and email.

skills.name: Component Catalog
skills.description: Defines a catalog of allowed components and actions with Zod schemas so model output can only use those components.

skills.name: Cross-Platform Renderers
skills.description: Renders one spec in React, Vue, Svelte, SolidJS, React Native, Ink terminals, Remotion video, PDF, or HTML email.

skills.name: Progressive Streaming
skills.description: Streams and renders specs progressively as the model responds, using the SpecStream utilities in the core package.

skills.name: MCP Apps Integration
skills.description: Serves json-render UIs as MCP Apps for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code through the @json-render/mcp package.

skills.name: Prebuilt shadcn Components
skills.description: Ships 36 prebuilt shadcn/ui components for React, plus shadcn-svelte components for Svelte, ready to use in a catalog.
